newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU cautiously welcomes freeing of Niger opposition.
newsitem.headline: EU cautiously welcomes freeing of Niger opposition.

text.p: The European Union said on Wednesday it cautiously welcomed last month's decision by the Niger government to free detained political opponents.
However, it said it was concerned that charges laid against the opposition leaders, arrested during a protest on January 11, had not been withdrawn.

"The EU calls on the Niger government to moderate its attitude towards the opposition and fully to respect fundamental freedoms, including freedom of speech and of the press," a statement issued by the Dutch EU Presidency said.

The EU froze aid to Niger in January 1996 after a coup led by Lieutenant-Colonel Ibrahim Bare Mainassara ousted the country's first democratically elected president. Mainassara remained in power after November elections, boycotted by the opposition.
In October, Niger appealed to the European Union for aid in organising the elections.
